title: audit detail task.model_consent
description: detail of audit rows with action task.model_consent: a person allowed DFX model access for the task while its own access is used up (POST /v1/tasks/{task}/model-consent, ADR-080 section 5; target the task); `changed` is false when the task had the consent already. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
